verdict.rationale: Tax calculation is a fair axis for a billing platform, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions sales tax, VAT, or GST calculation, tax registrations, or a tax-engine integration. The Stripe invoice integration and marketplace invoicing show invoices being pushed to other systems for payment collection, not tax being calculated, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a finance lead, sales tax, VAT, and GST are calculated on every invoice — natively or through a first-class tax integration — with the right registrations and rates
